lines.text: SUB BY : DENI AUROR@ https://aurorarental.blogspot.com/ Are you ready, kids?

* who lives in a pineapple under the sea? * * Spongebob Squarepants! * * absorbent and yellow and porous is he. * * Spongebob Squarepants! * * if nautical nonsense be something you wish... * * Spongebob square pants! * * then drop on the deck and flop like a fish. * * Spongebob Squarepants! * * ready? Spongebob Squarepants! * * Spongebob Squarepants!
Squidward, this is the best souffle you have ever created!
Patrick, you're my best friend in the whole neighborhood.
Patrick, you are the dumbest idiot It has ever been my misfortune to know.
Do you really think that, Spongebob?
Anyone with eyes could see that.
Yeah, well, i think you're ugly!
Patrick, what are you talking about?
Spongebob I no longer wish to know you...
You give bottom dwellers a bad name.
If i had a dollar For every brain you don't have I'd have one dollar.
Hey, Patrick I heard there was a job opening Down at the pet shop...
That makes you a big dummy, you dummy!
Yeah, well, that means that, uh... so are you!
You know what else is yellow?
Well, it doesn't matter what you call me Because i never want to see you again anyway!
Oh... i know what to do But i should wash my hands first.
So, what are we going to do tonight Best friend?
Well, i was going to practice My clarinet solo.
They're no fun anyway, right, gary?
Squidward will be performing his version Of "solitude in 'e' minor."
Aw, what am i worried about?
I can name three right off the bat.
No, no, no, get away from me!
No, no, no! I didn't mean that.
So dumb Patrick fell asleep on you, huh?
A real friend would perform for you.
I've been playing bassinet for years.
* Squidward is my best friend in the world... *
* Squidward is my best friend in the sea. *
* likes Patrick more than Spongebob. * * Patrick is a dirty, stinky, rotten friend, Squidward! * Um, i can fix this.
So, uh, i'll see you tomorrow, Squidward.
Feel like i need to scrub myself.
Hey, buddy, i warmed it up for you.
So this is what i find, huh?!
My best friend and my ex-Best friend And rubber bath toys!
This can't be happening to me!
I need a plan to get those two back together And out of my hair.
I'd much rather dine with you Than that lousy...
I'm not sitting near that maniac!
I thought you two were my best friends.
I am your best friend. I am your best friend.
Well, how about some soda, guys?
How about some for your best friend?
Can i have some now, buddy?
Sorry, boys, i'm all out of pop.
I'm going to go get some more.
Why don't you just stay here and chat?
I should just walk away right now.
I invited them in and i left them alone.
Well, Squidward, what have we learned today?
Me and Spongebob are friends again.
Don't you want us to help clean up?
The big boating exam is today.
I'm ready, i'm ready, i'm ready.
No, i'm ready to pass my boating test.
I'm ready, i'm ready, i'm ready...
Well, pal, i won't be needing you anymore.
I'm ready, i'm ready, i'm ready, oh, yeah!
Hey, i just got my license.
I'm ready, i'm ready, i'm ready, i'm ready, i'm ready.
Today is the day i pass my boating exam.
First i must pass the oral exam.
I am confident i will successfully succeed.
What is the front of the boat?
Port, skipper, deck, cabin Galley, keel, 1924.
Now it's time to once again take the driving portion of the exam.
Oh, in this boat, right here?
All you have to do is get on the track.
Okay, Spongebob, what's the first thing you do?
First thing is to start the boat.
Okay, now, what do you do next?
I'm tired of failing that boating test.
Spongebob, this is star ranger, over.
I got a surprise for you.
Oh, Patrick, i'm not in the mood.
Go to your closet for a surprise.
What's pink and square at the same time?
I've got too much to worry about.
I can't pass my boating exam.
Until i get behind the wheel.
I just need something To help me think straight.
Thinking straight is what i do.
You drive, and i'll do all the thinking for you.
How are we going to do that?
Hey, i can hear you in my head.
This is great-- While i'm taking the test You can give me all the answers.
Won't i look silly with this antenna coming out of my head?
Pat to sponge, pat to sponge, testing, testing.
Testing, testing, testing, testing, testing Testing, testing!
Sponge to pat, i read you loud and clear, over.
You're ready to get that license.
No, no... get in the boat.
What's the first thing you do?
It's okay, it's only the boat.
What's the second thing you do?
No, no... put it in drive.
Okay, you're coming To your first turn.
Please, tell me you know what to do At the first turn.
Oh, my, this is splendid, Spongebob.
You've shown the most spectacular improvement Of any student i've ever seen.
What's your secret-- A little radio in your head?
Oh, and under that hat Is some kind of antenna?
And some guy miles away from here Is giving you all the answers.
You... you've let go of the wheel.
I do have an antenna under my hat.
There is a guy giving me all the answers.
It's all right, you can cheat.
I'm sorry for letting you down again, mrs. Puff.
Only now i don't even have my bike.
All right, let's go surprise someone at the hospital.
